gloss: to knit, to braid, to weave

definitions.explanation: To create fabric by interlocking loops of yarn with needles.
To weave strands together into a pattern.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}が{手編|てあ}みのマフラーを{作|つく}ってくれた。
examples.english: My mother made me a hand-knitted scarf.

examples.japanese: {髪|かみ}を{三|み}つ{編|あ}みにする。
examples.english: I braid my hair into a three-strand plait.

notes:
{編|あ}む is used for creating fabric or patterns by interlocking or weaving strands.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Takes を particle: セーターを{編|あ}む

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {手編|てあ}み: hand-knitted
- {三|み}つ{編|あ}み: three-strand braid
- {編|あ}み{物|もの}: knitting, knitted item
- {編|あ}み{針|ばり}: knitting needle

RELATED:
- {織|お}る: to weave (on a loom)
- {縫|ぬ}う: to sew
